title: Mixed Event — Never Give Up Cooking! — Episode7 Never Give Up!

meta.Event Outline: Tsukasa and Saki invite Toya over for a party. With White Day approaching, he wants to give something back to the two of them. He tries his hand at baking from scratch, with varying results...

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I hope everything went well for Toya after that... And I really hope that they liked what he made...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Thank you for waiting, Miku.
Here's your coffee. Please use as much milk and sugar as you like.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay. Thank you, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, I made some fruitcake for a little test run. Would you like to try some...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, it's very colorful...
Strawberries, kiwis and pineapples. It's very pretty and it looks delicious.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, it's important for treats like these to be appetizing visually...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Appetizing visually...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (The cupcakes Toya made ended up looking not very good... I guess it appearance does matter...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (But I still don't understand why they mushroomed the way they did...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Also, I did my best to make it as fluffy as possible!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, a cake's texture does matter a lot...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Exactly!
Making it soft and fluffy is also one the best parts of baking them.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That just means you have to put in a lot of baking powder, right?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, that's actually not a good idea. If you put in too much, your cake will likely balloon out of control and fall apart.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Not only that, it won't taste very good, and there's a chance of it becoming incredibly bitter.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: R-Really?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Oh no. Did I give Toya instructions that I shouldn't have...?)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Is something wrong, Miku?
You went quiet all of a sudden...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Um, so... The thing is...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Toya asked me to help him bake cupcakes as gifts for his dear friends...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I know I'm realizing this too late, but I'm starting to get worried...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You taught him how to bake, Miku...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Y-Yes... Wait, what do you mean by that...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh dear... She tried to teach him...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: This... Sounds like it didn't end very well...
Toya's Room

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I feel exhausted. It must be because I tried doing something I'm not used to today...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Also, I feel terrible about having Kamishiro eat those horrible things...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Still, I want them to turn out well next time...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(Oh, before I forget...
I really need to thank Miku for helping me...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Toya, are you free right now?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Miku...? Oh, KAITO, you're here too.
How can I help?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I wanted to hear how things went today. So, did they turn out okay?>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <KAITO also wanted to hear what happened, so he decided to come along.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Haha. I mean, Toya, we were a little worried about you is all.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You were...? Actually, I'm glad you're here. I was just about to head over to SEKAI myself.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Miku, thank you for helping me today. I appreciate all the advice you gave me.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<You're welcome, but...
Did your cupcakes turn out okay? Did they taste good?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Um, well...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I can't say that they tasted good...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Oh, I see...>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm sorry. I wasn't able to put what you said into practice, Miku...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <No, I doubt that was the problem.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <After just speaking to KAITO about this, I realize now that my ideas regarding how to bake a delicious cake weren't entirely correct.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Which is probably the reason why your cupcakes turned out the way they did. I'm so sorry, Toya...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I also feel terrible about the friend you asked to be your taster...>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Miku...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
It's okay, really.
I know you did your best to teach me, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And I greatly appreciate what you did.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Toya...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Yes, there's no need to feel so down! Especially since things don't always go according to plan when you're learning how to bake.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <So, Toya, what do you plan on doing now? Do you still want to bake more cupcakes...?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, of course, since they're for those who are very near and dear to me.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <I see...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Then, I'll help you with your next batch...!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
You will?
But you're usually so busy, KAITO...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Don't mind me! I'm sure Len would be totally fine on his own now.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Wait, what does Len have to do with this...?>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Oh, um... Nothing!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <I-In any case, you don't have to worry about me! However, it's getting late, so why don't we try baking in SEKAI tomorrow?>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <In the meantime, I'll ask MEIKO again to see if we can borrow her kitchen!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
I'll be looking forward to it...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(Now KAITO's going to help...
I couldn't ask for more.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, quite a few people have been helping me lately...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(They've given me so much...
So, for their sake, I need to succeed this time.)
The next day
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Alright, Toya, let's start baking some cupcakes!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, let's.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Good luck, you two.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you for letting us borrow your kitchen like this, MEIKO. I really appreciate it...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It's my pleasure since you've been trying so hard lately. I want to give you all the support I can.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
You can do it, Toya!
Also, lemme try some once they're done!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, me too!
I'll be more than happy to taste test for you!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Well, things are already starting to get lively.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Um, KAITO, can I ask you something?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hm? Yes?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Would you mind teaching me as well...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The thing is... This has been bothering me all since yesterday...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm worried that I'm not as good a cook as I think I am...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Because of that, I ended up causing Toya a lot of trouble yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So, in order to do a better job of being a teacher next time, I'd like to learn how to cook and bake properly.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes, of course...!
Let's do our best together, Miku!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hmm... Yes, I see... Based on your story, Toya, I suspect that the way you mixed your batter has everything to do with them not rising properly.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Baking sweets is a delicate art.
As such, even when mixing the batter, you need to be careful.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So, Miku was right about that...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes! She made an astute observation there!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: However, well... There's no way for you to know how to mix them right without learning first.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So, we'll keep that in mind as we do this together.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: In order to make the meringue, you'll need to mix the egg whites while gradually adding in the sugar until you get these peaks.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Peaks...?
Yes, I suppose they are...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: They do look like little mountains. I think they're pretty.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Don't they?
Now, once the meringue's done, you'll put it into the bowl with the yolks...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But you'll need to mix it by gently cutting into it and folding it over. Otherwise, you risk pushing all the air out.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: By doing so, you should end up with a soft and fluffy texture. So, Toya, give it a try.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: O-Okay...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: MEIKO? Is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hm? Oh, I'm just enjoying seeing them do their best.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Anyway, I should probably get some coffee ready...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, can I have some with lots of milk and sugar?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Sure Rin, Len, would you two like some as well?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Since they're baking a delicious cake for us, I'll need to brew up some coffee to match.
